summary: News Corp filed a Form 8-K (Item 8.01) to disclose daily share repurchase updates provided to the ASX under its existing $1 billion stock buyback program. The program covers Class A and B common stock; no specific terms, prices or dates are stated. The board previously authorized the repurchases per market conditions. The report is procedural disclosure of ongoing capital return activities. What to watch: actual repurchase pace and market reaction to the buyback scale.
